elvs_hooded_sweat_jacket1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_hooded_sweat_jacket1.description: A hooded sweat jacket with zip front for female makehuman models. Hood is in the down position zip is up. Fits with a tight fitting shirt underneath it. Basic texture included.

elvs_male_boho_top1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_male_boho_top1.description: A bohemian inspired top for makehuman male models. Quad model and one simple texture included.

elvs_male_shirt_tie_tucked1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_male_shirt_tie_tucked1.description: A shirt for male makehuman models consisting of a tie and tucked in bottom. Quad based model and one simple texture included.

elvs_male_shirt_untucked_bd1.author: Elvaerwyn
elvs_male_shirt_untucked_bd1.description: A shirt for makehuman male models consisting of a buttoned untucked shirt. Quad based model and one simple texture included.

ews_striped_shirt.author: EWS
ews_striped_shirt.description: My first piece of clothing I ever made. It's a striped wool croptop kind of shirt with long sleeves.

janexx_old_female_sweater.author: janexx
janexx_old_female_sweater.description: A sweater for female models - worn out with patches in a handpainted style. Diffuse and normal map provided.

mindfront_cardigan_long_open_front.author: Mindfront
mindfront_cardigan_long_open_front.description: Tags: Female Sweater Cardigan. Long open-front cardigan. Loose knitted net fabric uses the alpha channel for transparency. Looks best with at least one level of subsurf. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 3mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles and I used proportional edit and sculpt to adjust the cardigan to fit the character and pose.

mindfront_knitted_sweater_01.author: Mindfront
mindfront_knitted_sweater_01.description: Tags: Sweater. Unisex hand knitted sweater. The normal map looks better at lower strength. In Blender use the 'solidify' modifier with 'Thickness' about 4mm and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give it some thickness. Preview image rendered in Blender Cycles.

mindfront_knitted_sweater_02.author: Mindfront
mindfront_knitted_sweater_02.description: Tags: Sweater. Unisex hand knitted sweater. In Blender use the 'solidify' modifier with 'Thickness' about 4mm and 'Fill Rim' and 'Only Rim' to give it some thickness. Preview image rendered in Blender Cycles.

mindfront_lusekofta.author: Mindfront
mindfront_lusekofta.description: Tags: Female Sweater Cardigan. A Norwegian cardigan 'Lusekofte' ends with an 'a' in Swedish machine knitted wool and front black stripes made of velvet. I found it in a closet never used and wanted to make a virtual version before giving it away. The buttons on the real sweater is loosely fixed with a thread and the buttonholes is a knitted loop. I decided not to add the knitted buttonholes as they wont show behind the buttons. The mesh is low poly and looks best with at least one level of subsurf. I use the slot for displacement for the metal mask texture. In Blender use the Solidify modifier with thickness about 3mm fill rim and only rim to give the fabric some thickness. The preview image is rendered in Blender Cycles.

punkduck_deathnote_t-shirt.author: punkduck
punkduck_deathnote_t-shirt.description: This T-Shirt featuring the japanese manga series 'death note' is made by o4saken. My only work are a few fixes I added a delete group and I upload everything so it should work with MakeHuman directly. The shirt was originally build for a male character but also works for females. Maybe you also have to fix a few vertices in Blender when you combine it with pants. For females it should work with the tight jeans. Please mention o4saken as the real author. The litsphere is used to make the normal map visible. I added diffuse map and normal-map but not the spec-map because it consists of a pattern which is not identical with the cloth itself . For the example picture it was sufficient to connect diffuse-map and glossy shader ... Thanx a lot for this work o4saken

punkduck_lace_up_blouse.author: punkduck
punkduck_lace_up_blouse.description: A long sleeve lace up blouse with a collar which is similar to Edwardian or Victorian style. I used it in combination with the costume leggings with leather texture . It also works with the tight jeans. No delete groups are used because it is 25 transparent looks more transparent in MakeHuman than in Blender . To get the best effect in Blender you should work with translucence. A node setup is appended as a bump texture

punkduck_off-shoulder_long-sleeve_top.author: punkduck
punkduck_off-shoulder_long-sleeve_top.description: This is a rather interesting piece of cloth. It is 10 transparent so no delete-groups are used. The shirt is designed to fit to the tight jeans and the strapless bra. You may change the small rings to a shiny material in Blender. In Makehuman the leather litsphere is used to make the normal-map visible.
